entities.summary: Luis, a notable figure in the history of Paraguay, associated with Democratic Transition and Political Instability (1989–2008). Preceded by Fragile Democracy and Colorado Dominance. Their legacy influenced Lugo removed by 'parliamentary coup' — June 22, 2012 and Fernando Lugo ends 61 years of Colorado rule.
